definition: One ID per organisation, same in every CSV
limitations: Rename/merge aliases before adding rows

definition: Disclosed ceiling, commitment or funded value of the relationship
unit_or_allowed_values: whole USD; blank if not disclosed
source_or_rule: Primary document wording; 'up to' kept as ceiling and flagged in notes
missing_value_rule: Blank = not disclosed. Never 0. Amounts in shares (warrants) stay blank, size is in notes
limitations: Ceilings are not realised cash flows; amounts of different types (investment vs purchase commitment) are not additive

definition: Category of the relationship
source_or_rule: Team vocabulary; 'guarantee' added for credit support
limitations: Types are the team's coding, not legal categories

definition: Direction of the disclosed flow of capital, payment or credit support: investor->investee, payer->payee (customer->supplier), lender->borrower, guarantor->beneficiary
source_or_rule: Rule fixed so that A->B->A means money/support goes out and a payment comes back
limitations: Direction follows money, not goods; two edges (investment and purchase) are separate rows

definition: confirmed = relationship stated in a party-issued document I opened (company release, SEC filing, official post); provisional = only secondary source, amount unsettled, or letter of intent. Amounts may be blank in both.
limitations: 'confirmed' means the text was read, not independently audited. Run MVP on confirmed only and compare with confirmed+provisional

definition: Day the relationship became public (filing date for SEC documents). Filled only when the day is verified; otherwise empty and announcement_month is used
missing_value_rule: empty = day not verified (not a guess). For market tests use announcement_date, else the LAST day of announcement_month, to avoid look-ahead
limitations: Use filing/announcement date, not deal date, to avoid look-ahead in any market test

definition: Directed path that returns to its start through 2 or 3 companies (A->B->A, A->B->C->A) using edges in relationships.csv
limitations: Formal cycles may not be economic round-tripping; private nodes allowed in graph but excluded from returns

definition: An undisclosed amount is not zero and must not be imputed
limitations: Score must treat empty as 'not disclosed' and report how many edges are empty

definition: True if the stock is exchange-listed and has returns in prices.csv
limitations: Private nodes (OpenAI, Anthropic, SB Energy) have no price series

definition: Reported debt at period end; the line/tag used varies by company, see the 10-K in source_url
limitations: Tags differ by company (LongTermDebt, DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount, LongTermDebtNoncurrent) so values are not perfectly comparable

definition: CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue at period end
limitations: Excludes marketable securities / short-term investments, so net_debt is overstated for NVDA and MSFT

definition: total_debt - cash_and_equivalents (computed here)
limitations: No published net debt figure was available to cross-check

definition: Operating income + D&A
source_or_rule: Team-collected from the 10-K in source_url; calculation method to be documented
missing_value_rule: blank (not zero); currently blank for Microsoft and Alphabet
limitations: Forecast or consensus EBITDA is not stored (out of project scope). If EBITDA <= 0 do not use Net Debt/EBITDA

definition: FY = fiscal year (10-K), Q1..Q4 = fiscal quarter (10-Q) as labelled by the company
limitations: Only FY rows at present. Do not mix quarter and year values in one ratio

definition: Daily close adjusted for splits and dividends
source_or_rule: yfinance (Yahoo Finance) via src/fetch_prices.py; cross-check two dates against Nasdaq/NYSE official close
limitations: Yahoo is unofficial and rate-limited; CRWV listed 2025-03-28 so common window starts then

definition: SPY (S&P 500 ETF) used as simple benchmark
limitations: ETF, adjusted close incl. dividends

definition: Month of public disclosure, always filled when known
limitations: Month-level precision for R009, R014

definition: Company-level status derived from relationships.csv: confirmed if at least one confirmed relationship with a set member, else unverified
source_or_rule: Computed rule; separate vocabulary from relationships.evidence_status
limitations: 'unverified' means not proven in sources I opened, not that no link exists

definition: source_url = company page; relationship_source_url = document showing the company's link to the set
limitations: Unverified companies show a secondary source or nothing

definition: Date the row's source/evidence was reviewed by the team
missing_value_rule: Empty if no review date was recorded
limitations: Records review timing, not the announcement or effective date

definition: R001 (up to $100B, 2025-09-22) is a letter of intent later replaced by R003 ($30B equity, 2026-02-27); R002 belongs to the same LOI. Summing R001 and R003 as one capital flow would give $130B
source_or_rule: Use R003 for NVIDIA->OpenAI materiality; keep R001 and R002 for history only
limitations: The file has no exclude flag, so the code must apply this rule explicitly
